content: A life of joy and happiness is possible only on the basis of knowledge and science.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation: True spiritual illumination does not conflict with rigorous scientific inquiry; both seek to understand reality as it is, liberating humanity from superstition and fear.
practicalInsight: Apply critical, objective reasoning to an emotional worry today. Distinguish factual reality from ungrounded assumptions.
reflectionPrompt: Where is superstitious anxiety clouding my rational clarity?
